decision.observation: Stamina is fully green again with the yellow hatched tail. Palm trunks cast long shadows across the red sand; inland lies a grass-topped bank with palm/banana grove, boulders and pale driftwood planks, and the sea on the left.
decision.hypothesis: This beach strongly resembles the spawn beach seen at 'DAY ONE' (palms, driftwood, dry grass bank) — I may have landed back near the starting area. Either way, inland up the bank is the route.
decision.memory: Landing beach resembles the original spawn beach; drivable bank with grass, boulders, driftwood inland.
